explanationMd:
Test whether each proposed statement can be added consistently to the rules. "Memo must be in position 2." is incompatible with every permitted order. The alternative statements each have a complete valid example, given in their feedback. To check impossibility, enumerate placements for the most restricted item or block, then remove every case breaking a rule.

Complete permitted orders (each arrow advances one position):
- Form → Letter → Notice → Report → Memo
- Form → Notice → Letter → Report → Memo
- Letter → Form → Memo → Notice → Report
- Letter → Form → Notice → Memo → Report
- Letter → Report → Memo → Notice → Form
- Letter → Report → Notice → Memo → Form
- Notice → Form → Letter → Memo → Report
- Notice → Report → Letter → Memo → Form
- Report → Letter → Notice → Form → Memo
- Report → Notice → Letter → Form → Memo
